Level 2 all-in and level 6 Depth Charge spikes are correctly identified against an immobile mage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeatedly names a fabricated Hwei ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', in focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.feeding, report[5].t and report[9].t. Hwei's real CC ability per the kit is Subject: Torment (E) — cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, hardCC/slow flags. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit (lint flag), and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lint flags).
audit.why: enemyAbilities in the brief lists P/Q/W/E/R as Signature of the Visionary / Subject: Disaster / Subject: Serenity / Subject: Torment / Spiraling Despair — there is no 'Subject: Fear' or 'CC Paints' anywhere in Hwei's kit.
audit.corrected: Replaced every instance of the fabricated name with Subject: Torment (E) and its real cooldown; rewrote the two copy-paste-bleed fields and the templated breakdown.trading.

edits.before: - Nautilus vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Engage when their answer is down — the chain only needs one clean start. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Nautilus vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Engage when their answer is down — the chain only needs one clean start. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)'s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. It writes your spacing rules. - W Titan's Wrath is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — his CC lives here, and dodging it stops the chain. It writes your spacing rules. - Your W (Titan's Wrath, 12s) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R (120/100/80s) opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: All his CC lives on Subject: Torment (E) — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Your W (Titan's Wrath) punishes him standing in melee — shield up before you walk into his poke range, not after he's already hit you.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment (E) — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: His poke wins a stationary trade — walking up to auto-trade into an unspent Q (Devastating Fire) is chip damage you can't return.

edits.before: Good trade: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all. Bad trade: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Good trade: dodge his charged Q and E (Subject: Torment) casts, then close with your own Q before he can recast. Bad trade: walking into his max-range poke with no engage answer up.

edits.before: If Hwei’s duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only — peel only and rebuild through vision and engage discipline.
edits.after: If Hwei's duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Torment (E) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only and rebuild through vision and engage discipline.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Hwei's Subject: Torment (E): his CC lives here, and dodging it stops the chain. Forward steps wait for its downtime.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)'s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry's damage online. Make him flinch first.
